diagnosis.what_happened: Agent attempted to retrofit a 3-column table structure by executing naive, unanchored regex prepends and string concatenations across markdown deliverables. Successive batch executions recursively duplicated the header and data cell tokens.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The lack of idempotency guards in the regex scripts caused repeated modifications to the same strings, duplicating tokens up to 9 times and corrupting the table.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Tables must be generated natively with the correct 3-column prefix structure, and any post-hoc restructuring must use deterministic DOM-based parsing or pristine array regeneration.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Idempotency ensures that scripts can be run multiple times safely. Regex on unstructured table strings is fragile and prone to state corruption.

desired_behavior: 1. Enforce a strict 3-column prefix architecture ('ردیف', 'متغیر', 'مؤلفه') natively upon generation. 2. Row numbers strictly decoupled from variable/subscale text strings. 3. Total prohibition of non-idempotent regex string manipulation on tables. 4. Mandate DOM-based parsing or pristine array regeneration for table restructuring.
generalization: Idempotent DOM-based table architectures prevent token duplication and state corruption compared to naive regex string manipulation.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero non-idempotent regex table mutations allowed
